faqs.q: Can you repair a small roof leak?
faqs.a: We assess the source of the leak and explain whether a targeted repair is suitable.

faqs.q: How long does a replacement take?
faqs.a: Timing depends on roof size, materials, weather, and any hidden damage. We confirm an estimated schedule before work begins.

faqs.q: Will you clean up after the job?
faqs.a: Cleanup is included in the agreed scope. We remove job debris and inspect the work area before leaving.
